scope: Exploratory causal control: remove the hard anchor-probability cutoff only; not held-out validation or deployment approval
warmup: Require30preceding integer-second frames; reference area is median of all30raw areas including zero when absent
anchor_selection: Among preceding30frames where donor was not quarantined and raw area>=.5current reference median, choose highestp10; ties choose newest. No hard probability cutoff. Freeze this raw boolean mask at the trigger.
trigger: For each collapsed donor, every other original object owning>=.5of its frozen anchor region becomes a directed donor/receiver conflict. No identity labels or ground truth used.
recovery: Three consecutive frames require donor area>=.5saved reference, donor owns>=.5anchor region and receiver owns<=.1anchor region. Otherwise reset recovery count. The third restored frame releases the pair before naming.
ordering: Assess active conflicts for recovery; discover new pairs from history; suppress all IDs in any active pair; append current areas/mask/probabilities to history with conflict membership.
output: Retain original LCC boxes. Permit a named seed only when basep10>=.7 and original objectID is not in any active pair. Anonymous seeds never become named; no relabeling or auto-enrollment.
limitations: Anchors are historical positions, not identity proofs. Real movement can delay recovery indefinitely; appearance corroboration is not implemented.
No parameter sweep or cow/time-specific rule. Inspecting prior failure episodes informed this method; results are exploratory, not independent validation.
No new inference and no reserved1800–2099or2700–2999frames. All original error and coverage denominators retained.
